content.text: Compositing the current mark onto GitHub light/dark backgrounds so we can see the contrast issue, then adding the dark variant.

input.command:
python3 << 'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

light_mark = Image.open('/tmp/clanker-preview/lettermark.svg.png').convert('RGBA')
dark_mark = Image.open('/tmp/clanker-preview/lettermark-dark.svg.png').convert('RGBA')

# Fit mark width to ~560px
def fit(im, width=560):
    w, h = im.size
    nh = int(h * width / w)
    return im.resize((width, nh), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)

light_mark = fit(light_mark)
dark_mark = fit(dark_mark)

GH_LIGHT = (255, 255, 255, 255)
GH_DARK = (13, 17, 23, 255)  # #0d1117

panel_w, panel_h = 640, 320

def panel(bg, mark, title, note):
    canvas = Image.new('RGBA', (panel_w, panel_h), bg)
    # center mark
    x = (panel_w - mark.width) // 2
    y = 70
    canvas.alpha_composite(mark, (x, y))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    color = (36, 41, 47) if bg[0] > 128 else (240, 246, 252)
    muted = (110, 110, 110) if bg[0] > 128 else (139, 148, 158)
    draw.text((24, 20), title, fill=color)
    draw.text((24, panel_h - 36), note, fill=muted)
    return canvas

# Current mark on both backgrounds
row1_l = panel(GH_LIGHT, light_mark, 'GitHub light · current #161719', 'Readable')
row1_d = panel(GH_DARK, light_mark, 'GitHub dark · current #161719', 'Nearly invisible')
# Proposed dark variant
row2_l = panel(GH_LIGHT, dark_mark, 'GitHub light · proposed #F0F6FC', 'Wrong for light')
row2_d = panel(GH_DARK, dark_mark, 'GitHub dark · proposed #F0F6FC', 'Readable')

top = Image.new('RGBA', (panel_w * 2, panel_h))
top.paste(row1_l, (0, 0)); top.paste(row1_d, (panel_w, 0))
bot = Image.new('RGBA', (panel_w * 2, panel_h))
bot.paste(row2_l, (0, 0)); bot.paste(row2_d, (panel_w, 0))
out = Image.new('RGBA', (panel_w * 2, panel_h * 2))
out.paste(top, (0, 0)); out.paste(bot, (0, panel_h))
path = '/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/assets/benchmark/.lettermark-theme-preview.png'
# put preview in /tmp instead of repo
path = '/tmp/clanker-preview/theme-comparison.png'
out.convert('RGB').save(path, 'PNG')
print(path, out.size)

input.command:
python3 << 'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import math

src = Image.open('/tmp/clanker-preview/lettermark.svg.png').convert('RGBA')
w, h = src.size
# Crop to content: find non-white pixels
pixels = src.load()
minx, miny, maxx, maxy = w, h, 0, 0
for y in range(h):
    for x in range(w):
        r,g,b,a = pixels[x,y]
        if abs(r-255)+abs(g-255)+abs(b-255) > 30:
            minx = min(minx,x); miny = min(miny,y); maxx = max(maxx,x); maxy = max(maxy,y)
print('bbox', minx, miny, maxx, maxy)
cropped = src.crop((minx, miny, maxx+1, maxy+1))

def themed(im, letter_rgb, bg_rgb):
    out = Image.new('RGBA', im.size, (*bg_rgb, 255))
    srcp = im.load(); outp = out.load()
    for y in range(im.size[1]):
        for x in range(im.size[0]):
            r,g,b,a = srcp[x,y]
            # darkness of original letter
            if abs(r-255)+abs(g-255)+abs(b-255) > 30:
                outp[x,y] = (*letter_rgb, 255)
    return out

light = themed(cropped, (22,23,25), (255,255,255))
dark = themed(cropped, (255,255,255), (13,17,23))

def fit(im, width=520):
    return im.resize((width, int(im.size[1]*width/im.size[0])), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)

light, dark = fit(light), fit(dark)
pad = 40
panel_w = light.width + pad*2
panel_h = light.height + pad*2 + 36
canvas = Image.new('RGB', (panel_w*2, panel_h))
# light panel
pl = Image.new('RGB', (panel_w, panel_h), (255,255,255))
pl.paste(light.convert('RGB'), (pad, pad+28))
# dark panel  
pd = Image.new('RGB', (panel_w, panel_h), (13,17,23))
pd.paste(dark.convert('RGB'), (pad, pad+28))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(pl); draw.text((16,10), 'Light · #161719 on #fff', fill=(100,100,100))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(pd); draw.text((16,10), 'Dark · #fff on #0d1117', fill=(160,160,160))
canvas.paste(pl, (0,0)); canvas.paste(pd, (panel_w,0))
path = '/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyot/assets/.preview-lettermark-themes.png'
# don't put in assets - use /tmp
path = '/tmp/clanker-preview/readme-themes.png'
canvas.save(path)
print('wrote', path, canvas.size)

content.text:
Dark mode check: the current `#161719` mark is nearly invisible on GitHub dark (`#0d1117`).

Added `assets/clanker-lettermark-dark.svg` with a white fill, and the README now swaps by theme:

```markdown
![Clanker lettermark](assets/clanker-lettermark.svg#gh-light-mode-only)
![Clanker lettermark](assets/clanker-lettermark-dark.svg#gh-dark-mode-only)
```

Light keeps `#161719`; dark uses `#FFFFFF`.
Both marks are showing because the `#gh-*-mode-only` fragments only work on github.com. Switching to a `<picture>` element so light/dark media queries pick one.
Switched to a `<picture>` element with `prefers-color-scheme`, so only the matching mark renders instead of stacking both.
